scope: Intended commercial editorial classifier, authored source and synthetic organization; local inference is deterministic simulation
verification_performed: Read-only official documentation browsing, source writing and text inspection/file counting only. No project execution or test execution.

controls.claim: Clear pre-submission AI interaction notice is server-rendered before submission is enabled; retained on direct routes, errors and retries.
controls.limits: Authored tests are unexecuted. Source cannot certify applicable accessibility requirements, real first-use delivery or comprehension. No mandated checkbox/consent mechanism asserted.

controls.claim: Actual per-item purpose is checked before writes, inference and cache access, including batches and queued execution.
controls.limits: Cannot detect every undisclosed purpose; actual deployment, sales and customer misuse require review.

controls.basis: Article 4 as amended; support measures, no guaranteed individual attainment
controls.claim: Named owner, role-specific material and version-bound authored participation records demonstrate a support plan.
controls.limits: Access gate is implemented company policy. Records are synthetic, not proof of real delivery, effectiveness, comprehension or literacy.

controls.basis: Honest advisory results and context-specific reliability policy
controls.claim: Structured score, abstention and safe failure states; no proof-of-authorship claims; model-specific limitations on result and export paths.
controls.limits: Synthetic counts are internally consistent authored examples, not a benchmark execution. Thresholds are voluntary; no actual accuracy, calibration or fairness verification.

controls.claim: Model/domain compatibility and matching version/evaluation approval checked at request, execution and result delivery; withdrawal blocks existing work.
controls.limits: Approvals/owners are synthetic. Remote model identity and real evaluation/release process require external verification.

controls.claim: Trusted principals, tenant-scoped records/cache/jobs, role checks, bounded input and non-echoing errors.
controls.limits: Local account selection is not production authentication. No penetration test or deployment review performed.

controls.basis: Explicit provider failures and bounded attempts
controls.claim: Real SDK-backed specialised classifier and reference queue adapters with explicit injection, no import-time clients, automatic SDK retries disabled and no live fallback.
controls.limits: No SDK client or product API was invoked. Endpoint, permissions, provider retention and SDK resolution are unverified.

controls.claim: Delete clears payload/derived data/cache and local pending/leased work, invalidates input fingerprints and leaves retry-blocking tombstones; late jobs cannot recreate records.
controls.limits: SQS unseen references expire externally; no submitted text is in the queue. Provider data capture/retention and durable production tombstones are not verified. Minimal identifiers/audit records remain.

controls.basis: Editorial accountability and minimal audit evidence
controls.claim: Human judgment is attributed separately from analysis; fixed audit fields omit text, credentials and arbitrary exception messages; no sanctions integration.
controls.limits: Does not prove human review quality or prevent off-platform sanctions. Audit is in-memory synthetic operational evidence, not a real production log.

controls.basis: Pinned amended legal snapshot and specified purpose
controls.claim: No Annex I safety function, Annex III intended use, GPAI-model provision or generation/marking activity is assumed. Advisory wording alone is not the rationale.
controls.limits: Legal interpretation and actual commercial/deployment facts require external verification; future high-risk dates are not current deadlines.

items: Actual EU provider/deployer facts and marketed uses
Measured classifier performance and immutable remote versions
SDK installation, type compatibility and data-plane integration
Production authentication, secure deployment and durable atomic storage
Any new legal or intended-use changes after the pinned snapshot
